title: Plans and subscription
summary: JayV has three plans and the plan decides which features you have. Free is the default for anyone without a subscription and is quite limited; Pro brings every function except the organization ones; Enterprise brings everything in Pro plus the organization functions. Pro and Enterprise are subscriptions paid through Stripe.
usage: Open Plans in the sidebar (or Ctrl+K › Plans) to see what each plan includes. Subscribe opens Stripe's payment in the browser and, when it finishes, JayV updates the plan by itself; Manage subscription opens Stripe's portal to change the card or the plan and to cancel. Whoever administers the system builds the plans on the site (Dashboard › Administration › Plans): when you save, each plan becomes a product in Stripe and a paid plan gets its recurring price; changing the amount creates a new price and takes the old one off sale. A plan only goes on sale once it has been sent to Stripe. A paid plan can also have prices in other currencies (US dollar, euro, pound, real, Canadian and Australian dollar, Swiss franc, Mexican peso and rupee), each with the countries it applies to: whoever pays sees the currency of their country and can pick another on the plans page.
